title: Will I make money?
subtitle: Drag the sliders. Every number is a rough estimate you can change.
losingEachSale: Each sale costs more than its price. Raise the price or cut costs.
aboveBreakEven: You cover your costs from {units} a month. 🎉
belowBreakEven: You need {units} a month to cover costs: {more} more to go.
priceHint: Each one costs you about {cost}, so charge at least {low} {per} to keep a healthy profit. Check what others near you charge.
cashHint: Starting with your budget, after buying what you need. Below the red line means you'd run short.
loanNeed: You may need about {amount} more than your budget. See the money-help schemes.
noLoan: Your budget covers the start and two months of costs. No loan needed. 👏
aiEstimates: These are AI estimates for a business like yours, just to get you started. Change any number to your real cost.
reEstimate: Suggest costs for my business again
reEstimateConfirm: Replace all your costs with fresh estimates? Any changes you made will be lost.
